title: Handmade and design objects (gallery)
when: Objects shot on one backdrop (ceramics, jewellery, decor and the like); the page reads like a gallery.

steps.when: one commercial promise on a dark bar: the usual choice

variants.when: a soft brand tint (kids, beauty, playful and premium looks)
2-3 short service promises the merchant confirmed

steps.when: a flat menu of up to 6-8 short items: the categories show on desktop

variants.when: a nested or long menu that would not fit as links
a short flat menu and a left-aligned look (journal, dense catalog)

steps.when: photography with a quiet zone for the live text
steps.note: Fit-screen or 2:1 with a native caption.

variants.when: one strong text-free image, full height on phones (journal, premium, dark drop)
a photo and a colour panel side by side (playful, premium)

steps.note: 4-5 columns of packshots, linked. Its title is a phrase about what the store sells: the storefront makes it the page's H1 (a banner title never is).

variants.when: more than 4 categories
two departments or audiences (women and men, adults and kids)

steps.when: the default story: eyebrow, a heading phrase, 16 px text at 560-640 px, a button to a real page, a 1:1 or 3:4 photo (`mediaRatio`; kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: One story block in the middle third that leads somewhere: a button or a last-line link to the catalog, a collection or the About page.

variants.when: no photo for the story: one centred statement of 100-200 characters ending with a link
native fallback the merchant edits in the cabinet: a narrowed section, `###` heading, one paragraph of 300 characters or less ending with a link
every packshot on one backdrop: an edge-to-edge product wall (gallery look)

steps.when: gallery and dense catalog: a mosaic of products or collections in tiles of different sizes (kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: The signature block: one block that only this store has, chosen by the look (references/looks.md).

variants.when: journal and premium: one brand phrase set large across the page (kit-custom-sections)
journal: a full-bleed photo pair with a corner caption, native
native fallback: two large images with an overlay title

steps.when: bigger cards for the second source, a change of rhythm

variants.when: every packshot on one backdrop: an edge-to-edge product wall (gallery look)
one curated row of 4

steps.when: two big collections instead of a category row

variants.when: a linked promo between shelves
a full-bleed photo pair (one per page)

steps.when: native fallback: an inspiration photo and a product collage with a caption

variants.when: 4 or more collection or story covers

steps.note: Payment and delivery, returns, care, custom orders.

variants.when: a centred theme and a brand-led page: a narrow column with air
a rounded theme (playful, soft): the questions on one card

steps.when: a centred form on a neutral band (centred themes)

variants.when: text left, form right: the usual closing band
on the footer palette, so the subscription and the footer read as one closing block

steps.when: off-white, grey or cream: soft and premium looks

variants.when: a dark closing band

notes: Cohesion lever: photos on one flat backdrop + `photo.fit: auto`, `backgroundColor: primary` + a base palette equal to the backdrop.
